# MiniTool MovieMaker

> Free video editing software and comprehensive tutorials for video/audio editing, format conversion, and multimedia content creation on Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android platforms.

MiniTool MovieMaker provides extensive guides covering video editing workflows, format conversions (MP4, WebM, AVI), audio extraction, social media optimization (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook), and comparisons with popular editing tools like Windows Movie Maker, CapCut, and iMovie. The site offers multilingual support with tutorials in English, Spanish, French, and Portuguese.

## Key Topics

- MiniTool MovieMaker
- Video editing and conversion
- Windows Movie Maker alternatives
- MP4, WebM, MOV format conversion
- Audio extraction from video
- CapCut and mobile video editing
- TikTok and Instagram video optimization
- Screen recording audio extraction
- Multi-platform support (Windows, Mac, iOS, Android)
- Free video editing software
- Social media video management
- FLAC and audio players
- Video compression and splitting
- Multimedia fusion without quality loss

## Video and Audio Editing Guides

- [Fusiona audio y video en uno sin pérdida de calidad | La mejor guía](https://moviemaker.minitool.com/es/editorvideo/combinar-audio-y-video.html): Guide to merge audio/video using MiniTool MovieMaker without quality loss
- [Comment extraire l'audio d'un MP4? Il existe 5 méthodes](https://moviemaker.minitool.com/fr/montage-video/extraire-audio-de-mp4.html): 5 methods to extract audio from MP4 to MP3 using various tools
- [Ferramentas poderosas para extrair áudio da gravação de tela](https://moviemaker.minitool.com/pt/editordevideo/extrair-audio-gravacao-de-tela.html): Tools to extract audio from screen recordings using MiniTool MovieMaker
- [Comment faire bouger une image avec des effets d'animation ou de mouvement](https://moviemaker.minitool.com/fr/montage-video/comment-faire-bouger-une-image.html): Animate static images with Adobe Express & MiniTool MovieMaker effects
